name: Öznur Duyum
bio:
Öznur Duyum was born in Istanbul. After completing her undergraduate degree in Business Administration, she graduated from the Graphic Design and Advertising department. She received training in graphic design, illustration, pattern design, photography, digital design, and basic art education. With the birth of her twins, she rediscovered children’s books. Approaching the field with a philosophical perspective, she has worked in writing, reading, and illustrating children’s books, and many of the books she has illustrated have been published to date.

Duyum meets children at school events and illustrator gatherings, and organizes both in-person and online workshops for adults and children. Her interviews and book reviews are published on literary websites.
